import urllib.request
# Try EuropePMC fulltext XML
url = 'https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC3496185/fullTextXML'
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
        data = r.read()
        print(f'Status: {r.status}, Length: {len(data)}, Type: {r.headers.get("Content-Type")}')
        print(f'First 300 bytes: {data[:300]!r}')
        if b'<article' in data[:1000] or b'<?xml' in data[:100]:
            with open('tasks/t0078_bedb_mobo_v2_ais_tiered_ahp/assets/paper/10.1016_j.neuron.2012.08.041/files/rivlin-etzion_2012_directional-preference-reversal.xml', 'wb') as f:
                f.write(data)
            print('Saved as XML')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Error: {e}')
